source_assessment.mapping: FirmwareScanout derives physical address from actual HHDM and verifies exact bootloader FRAMEBUFFER reservation coverage, finite <=8MiB extent, supported EL1 translation regime and every covering actual AT S1E1W translation. Mapping validator rejects faults, nonmatching physical pages, unsupported/mixed memory attributes and accepts only uniform Normal NC(0x44)/WB(0xff). Partial final mapping page is visited. No page table modifications or unchecked synthetic writable mapping introduced.
source_assessment.cache: WB preparation derives observed CTR_EL0 DminLine, rejects unsupported line sizes and non-whole-line buffer custody; touched line envelopes checked before writes, DC CVAC covers every touched line and DSB SY precedes return for both NC and WB. Invalid/overflowing/out-of-bound spans refuse before RawDisplay writes. These are architectural source checks, not independent physical coherency proof.
source_assessment.canonical_face: FirmwareFace composes existing ProductJourney, FrontDoor.open_creche_reviewed with actual Source candidates/current Host eligibility, canonical BirthDraft Face through mask.birth_basis, existing producer forwarding/checked Mask and acknowledged Show. No second Body model/renderer/kernel is introduced. Retains display, Mask, FrontDoor, ProductJourney and provider bases for product lifetime.
source_assessment.inputless: without_local_input is allowed only before scene/session exists; present forces interactions_admitted false, scene.disable_local_input suppresses hit regions/hints, and keyboard, pointer motion, pointer dispatch and semantic submit refuse. New tests inspect unchanged Face/current Show, no hit regions, read-only footer and no PgUp/F2 hints. Ordinary prepared Masks default to local input available, preserving prior entrance semantics.
source_assessment.resource_and_identity: Finite surface pixel/slot/byte limits checked; observed framebuffer Base/provider reused. Existing AArch64 caller constructs and validates ImageBoundHostOffer before preparation and passes embedded Make and same Boot identities. Genuine provider key comes through existing admitted entropy with_secret, not transport-provided authority. Renderer receipt must match actual Face and observed display Base and show positive scanout writes.
source_assessment.serial_identity_boundary: AArch64 product-ready record continues to describe the separate linear Host Face/presenter. The graphical Crèche has its own CONDUIT_FIRMWARE_FACE and mapping record. These are separate manifestations on same Host/Boot and must not be equated by artifact consumers.

acceptance_and_evidence_boundaries: PR body explicitly scopes G1/G2 slice and leaves #6057 open; five-architecture/current live-media routing/comparative gallery/readiness/persistent launcher remain pending, input tracked separately.
Canonical Crèche is a zero-Body prebirth owner presentation. Producer Source/Plan provenance does not prove candidate Plot/Body Source execution. Eligibility does not authorize Play.

Proof report explicitly names actual measured f96860659760660fc796e7694df5bee4bd9f2bb8, not unexecuted final documentary head; two boots have different legitimate initial names/HostBoot/Face identities.

Only observed 800x600 first read-only page is claimed. No local-input/navigation, second-mode, physical scanout/GPU/DMA/isolation, broad frame-update performance or calibrated rendering CPU time claim.

Retained broader local run exit143 and four ignored/manual controls are explicitly not full pass. Local checked test counts were inspected as source/report declarations, not independently run by this reviewer.
Root separately audits actual packet bytes and correspondence; this receipt does not promote README booleans or the two reported boot proofs into independently verified artifact claims.
Candidate/relevant combined Integration remain independent delivery gates.
review_limits: Read-only git-object review only; no builds, QEMU, Cargo/cache writes, source edits or GH/CI observations.
Architectural correctness assessed from committed code; no independently executed cache/translation hardware fault controls.
Review scope mapping/cache/canonical Face/MaskShow/inputless integration, not exhaustive all host-construction/collector changes.
